about_the_game:
The River of Time has dried up, plunging parallel worlds into chaos. True spirits that stirred ripples in the river have been resurrected, entering a realm governed by bizarre rules. A great calamity has arisen, and the path to transcendence has appeared.

1. Pet System

  • Over 720 types of monsters and mythical beasts await in the game.

  • Defeat enemies to obtain Pet Eggs—every monster, including bosses, can be tamed as a pet.

2. Gem System

  • Collect various gems and socket them into equipment to boost combat power.

3. Equipment System

  • Farm materials by defeating monsters and craft powerful gear using collected resources.

4. Skill System

  • Loot a diverse array of skills from monsters, with over 240 skill combinations to customize your playstyle.

5. Quest System

  • Immerse yourself in engaging storylines through the game's quest system.

6. Teleportation System

  • Instantly teleport to any map anytime, anywhere for convenient AFK monster grinding.

7. AFK System

  • Enjoy hands-free gameplay with the AFK feature—grind for equipment effortlessly while away from your screen.

8. Boss Battles

  • Encounter powerful bosses randomly in the wild. Defeat them to claim rare and valuable loot.

9. Auto-Loot

  • Automatically collect valuable items dropped by monsters during your adventures.

10. Additional Features

  • AFK mode, adjustable sound settings, auto-equipment selection, and more!

Join our QQ Group: 339510891
